title: Learning (SC02)
description: Closed field set for the Learning entity (the formalized 01/04/07 style .learnings record). Membership is verbatim from .distill/round-2/05-DATA-MODEL.md sec 6: 'Learning = all provenance columns of Evidence + identity(L0) + Pattern link + decay_type + last_validated_at/validation_state'. Evidence's provenance columns are exactly the sec 6 Evidence row: content_hash, scope, origin.*, evidence_refs[], evidence.status + status_basis, generation{}, record_locator, refs_integrity. Counters deliberately do NOT appear here: sec 6 puts support_count / distinct_occurrence_count / contradiction_count on Pattern (and use/view/patch on Artifact), and sec 4 M7 rules the three carriers 'forbidden to interoperate'. Because additionalProperties is false, a counter landed on a Learning record is rejected -- the sec 5.4 admission rule enforced structurally rather than by prose.

learning_id.$comment: Store primary key required by CM-24 content-addressed-idempotent-upsert; 05 sec 6 enumerates business columns only.

content_hash.$comment: 05 sec 5.2: sha256 of the normalized body (CRLF->LF, trailing whitespace removed, trailing blank lines removed, trim). Consumers: (a) exact-equality dedup, (b) content-equal short circuit, (c) the comparison target that expires verification[].artifact_sha. Prohibited from being the whole identity (sec 5.2 '禁止') -- identity is a separate field.

record_locator.$comment: 05 sec 2 row record_locator: the body stores only a reference to the store-side ledger; the authoritative provenance is not held by the recorded object itself (Agent 12 provenance_holder_rule).

pattern_ref.$comment: 05 sec 6 'Pattern link'. Existence of the target is the resolver's decision branch (sec 2.1 D2), not this schema's.

decay_type.$comment: 05 sec 3: exactly 5 values and `unknown` is deliberately allowed (age and usage cannot prove content is wrong).

last_validated_at.$comment: 05 sec 3: advances only when revalidation passes; nullable = never validated. `pattern` applies only when the value is a string (draft 2020-12), so null stays legal.

validation_state.$comment: 05 sec 3: written by the eval/audit runner; falls back to pending when the record disappears. A review is not a lifecycle event.

scope.$comment: 05 sec 5.3 S1: typed triple, non-empty and fail-closed -- a missing or unresolvable scope is refused, never defaulted to global. This is the structural block of the '02 computed cohort_key but never consumed it' defect.. SCOPE VS COHORT (Wave 1 integration): this object is 05-DATA-MODEL.md line 174's typed triple {workspace, project, layer} and nothing else. The identity triple of line 177 invariant 4 is a SEPARATE named object, `cohort` = {workspace, project, path}, whose key set is fixed by the frozen kernel kd_provenance.cohort_key (scripts/kd_provenance.py lines 55-63) and which is defined in schemas/scope-tuple.schema.json ($defs.cohort_triple) and schemas/evidence.schema.json. Support counting groups by `cohort`; promotion filtering branches on `scope.layer` (S10, Wave 3). One key never carries both meanings.

origin.$comment: 05 sec 2 rows 1-2: two non-empty texts, refused empty by the validator, not rewritable in place (a rewrite must ride a new lifecycle_event). source_refs may only name ids the writer actually opened.

path.$comment: 05 sec 2 row evidence_refs[]: 'path must be a canonical repository-relative path, brace/wildcard shorthand is forbidden'. Round 1 measured 132/132 paths missing the repo-root prefix and 3 brace shorthands, so the shape is rejected here rather than noted in prose.

evidenceStatus.$comment: 05 sec 2 row 4 + sec 4 M5: this is per-item evidence-gathering state, distinct from the scoring record verification[] which lives on the Artifact table (sec 6). Written only by the eval/audit runner.

status_basis.$comment: Points at one real run record. nullable rather than absent so 'no run record yet' is an explicit state, per sec 5.4 (3).

allOf.$comment: 05 sec 2 row 4: '无运行记录时只能是 UNVERIFIED' -- so claiming VERIFIED without a status_basis pointer is refused by construction.

generation.$comment: 05 sec 2 row 6: stamped by the assembly layer at write time, immutable, never self-reported by the worker; any rewrite creates a new entry linked by lifecycle_event.

refsIntegrity.$comment: 05 sec 2 row 11: a result bit written by a re-runnable auditor script, recomputed every round, fail-on-unresolved. `auditor` is the named writer, because 05 sec 1 red line 3 and sec 5.4 (1) forbid a decision field with no identifiable writer.

layer.$comment: 05 sec 6 gives Learning 'identity(L0)'. L1 is a Pattern-level hint layer and L2 embedding is not adopted (sec 5.1), so a Learning record claiming either fails with ENUM_OUT_OF_RANGE (S09 exit 2).

derivation.$comment: Same record shape emitted by kd_identity_key (S05). Kept structurally identical to SC03 so one derivation can be checked against both carriers; schemas stay self-contained per the brief (no cross-file $ref). 05 line 122 is TWO axes (canonical NUL-join ‖ explicit Pattern-Key) and the Pattern-Key is named by the model at Stage 3 step 12, so `canonical_fields` states what actually joined and the two keys below make a skipped axis visible; the field list itself stays DEFERRED (05 sec 7 DM-1).

canonical_fields.$comment: PROVISIONAL-CANONICAL-FIELD-SET: the adjudicated minimum (semantic + scope triple, bookkeeping excluded), bounded in count only; DM-1 defers the list.

absent_optional_fields.$comment: Declared canonical fields this record contributed nothing for; an empty array means every declared axis joined.

axes_participating.$comment: Which of DC-SP-1 gate 3's groups moved the digest for this record.
